subject: Renewal: plan to migrate Storium to Marketplace billing / co-sell alignment
messages:
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Alexa Gomez <agomez@storium.io>
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: plan to migrate Storium to Marketplace billing / co-sell alignment

Hi Alexa --

Quick note ahead of your Aug renewal: thanks again for the conversation last week. Storium is a great fit for our co-sell program and we think moving the renewal to AWS Marketplace billing will simplify procurement on your side (one invoice, consolidated licensing, easier chargeback) and unlock co-sell benefits for both teams.

High level proposal:
- Amendment to move existing subscription to "Redwood via AWS Marketplace" SKU at current committed price for the first renewal year.
- Target migration window: within 30 days after contract signature (we can align with your fiscal cadence).
- Redwood will own listing + metering setup; Storium signs a short marketplace amendment.

Can you share the procurement checklist and any internal approvals we should factor in? I attached a quick list of expected procurement questions. If it helps, I can loop in our AWS marketplace ops contact and send a DocuSign amendment to speed this.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
Attachment: Storium_Procurement_Request.pdf (PDF, 47KB)

From: Alexa Gomez <agomez@storium.io>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: plan to migrate Storium to Marketplace billing / co-sell alignment

Hi Kimberly,

Appreciate the outreach. Procurement is open to marketplace billing but we need a short checklist before we can recommend it internally. Key asks:
- Confirm final PRICING SKU and metering (monthly vs usage).
- Do we keep the same contract terms (data residency / SLA)?
- Any change to invoicing cadence and PO handling?

I've attached a standard form we use. If you can provide the SKU mapping and a draft amendment, I can circulate to finance and legal. Also please include any AWS co-sell partner contacts so we can coordinate procurement questions on their end.

--Alexa
Alexa Gomez
Head of Finance Ops, Storium
agomez@storium.io

Folks -- forwarding Storium's procurement reply. They need: SKU mapping, invoice cadence, and confirmation that terms (SLA/data residency) stay the same.

Can @sergio please start the co-sell intro with our AWS contact (cc'd in the header) and confirm whether we can preserve their current terms under the Marketplace amendment? @marissa, can you pull the deal pricing and confirm whether we can keep the same price on the marketplace SKU for year 1 of renewal (we have a competitive NRR target)?

Short replies appreciated so we can get Alexa a draft this week.

Thanks,
Kim

Kim / Marissa --

I can take AWS ops, will intro marketplace-ops@amazon.com and request SKU provisioning. Short answers:
- We can keep the same commercial terms in the amendment (SLA/data residency unchanged) — legal has approved the template.
- For invoicing, marketplace issues an invoice to Storium; we still surface usage in our console and provide usage reports for chargeback.
- Pricing: I recommend we preserve the current effective price for the first 12 months to reduce friction; we can mark that as a one-time promotional mapping in the marketplace SKU.

I'll draft a co-sell intro and attach a redwood marketplace amendment v1.

Sergio

Action items / timeline:
1) I attached the draft amendment (redwood-marketplace-amendment_v1.pdf). Please review and let me know any redlines by EOD Tue 6 Oct.
2) If acceptable, we'll send the DocuSign envelope and target signature by Wed 7 Oct.
3) Marketplace listing & SKU provisioning: AWS Ops (cc'd) will confirm SKU and billing metering after signature; expected activation within 48 hours of DocuSign completion.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/0A1B2C3D4E

Please reply with your preferred renewal activation date (we recommend 2026-11-01 to align with your billing cycle).
